subject: social_studies
concept: Understanding how social safety nets (healthcare, unemployment support, education funding) vary across different systems and their tradeoffs
source_inspiration: original content, following the Education Conduct Policy's evenhandedness principle — not sourced from any external text

exercise.pictorial: Student matches a social safety net approach to a tradeoff it involves (cost, coverage, individual choice)
exercise.abstract: Student presents both a benefit and a tradeoff of a described social safety net approach, without stating a personal opinion

misconception_flags: presents one safety net approach as having no tradeoffs whatsoever

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
